title: Duplicated push notification dispatch pattern
description: src/inbox.rs:774-789, 1041-1057, 1119-1135, 1340-1358, 1409-1426. Five nearly identical blocks spawn a tokio task to call send_push_notification with slightly different parameters (notification type, title, actor). This is a classic extract-to-function candidate. A helper like spawn_push(pool, persona_id, kind, title, actor, domain) would eliminate 50+ lines of duplicated closure boilerplate.
